description: Monotonicity / TVD gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 test tvd_monotone of problems/advection_1d_periodic_lax_friedrichs.esm (model AdvectionLaxFriedrichsTVD) at the default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The tent profile is advected at c=1; the assertions bound the state's max (no overshoot), min (no undershoot), and mean (exact conservation) — the sim-expressible form of the TVD claim. Assertions and tolerances live in the problem file; this manifest routes runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
